source_text:
φάγεσθε, φησὶν, ἕως εἰς αὐτὴν τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην, ἕως ἂν προσενέγκητε ὑμεῖς τὰ δῶρα τῷ Θεῷ ὑμῶν. Καιρὸς γὰρ ὁ πρέπων τοῦ χρῆναι μεταλαχεῖν τῆς νέας τε καὶ ἀκηράτου ζωῆς, μόνος ἂν γένοιτο, καὶ σφόδρα εἰκότως, καθ' ὃν ἐπέλαμψεν ὁ Ἐμμανουήλ. Ἱκανὸς δὲ πρὸ αὐτοῦ παντελῶς οὐδεὶς, εἰς νέαν ἡμᾶς ἀναστοιχειῶσαι ζωὴν, ἀπαρχὴ δὲ ὥσπερ καὶ πρῶτος αὐτὸς τῶν εἰς ἀφθαρσίαν ἐκτισμένων, καθὸ πέφηνεν ἄνθρωπος, καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ μεθ' ἡμῶν, διὰ τὴν πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὁμοίωσιν. Εἰσκεκόμικε δὲ παραχρῆμα τῆς ἁγίας ἡμῖν Πεντηκοστῆς προανατύπωσιν ἐναργῆ, ἑπτὰ χρῆναι λέγων ἐπαριθμεῖν ἑβδομάδας, τῇ τοῦ δράγματος εἰσκομιδῇ. Μετὰ γάρ τοι τὴν ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμέραν, ἑπτὰ συνείροντες ἑβδομάδας, ἑορτάζομεν οἱ πεπιστευκότες.
{ΠΑΛΛ.} Ὡς σαφὴς ὁ λόγος!
{ΚΥΡ.} Ὅτι δὲ τῆς τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν ἀναστάσεως ὁ καιρὸς μεθίστησι τοὺς ἡγιασμένους ἐν Πνεύματι, καὶ ἐν πίστει δεδικαιωμένους, εἰς τὸ δύνασθαι καρποφορεῖν τὴν νέαν τε καὶ ἀκίβδηλον ζωὴν, κατεδείκνυ σαφῶς οὕτω λέγων εὐθύς· «Καὶ προσοίσετε θυσίαν νέαν τῷ Κυρίῳ, ἀπὸ τῆς κατοικίας ὑμῶν προσοίσετε ἄρτους ἐπίθεμα, δύο ἄρτους, ἐκ δύο δεκάτων σεμιδάλεως ἔσται ὁ ἄρτος ὁ εἷς, ἐζυμωμένοι πεφθήσονται πρωτογεννημάτων τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ προσάξετε μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων ἑπτὰ ἀμνοὺς ἀμώμους ἐνιαυσίους, καὶ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βουκολίων, καὶ κριοὺς δύο ἀμώμους, καὶ ἔσονται εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ αἱ θυσίαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ σπονδαὶ αὐτῶν, θυσία ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας τῷ Κυρίῳ. Καὶ ποιήσουσι χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ δύο ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους εἰς θυσίαν σωτηρίου μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων τοῦ πρωτογεννήματος. Καὶ ἐπιθήσει αὐτὰ ὁ ἱερεὺς μετὰ τῶν ἄρτων τοῦ πρωτογεννήματος ἐπίθεμα ἐναντίον Κυρίου μετὰ τῶν δύο ἀμνῶν, ἅγια ἔσονται τῷ Κυρίῳ, τῷ ἱερεῖ τῷ προσφέροντι αὐτὰ αὐτῷ ἔσται. Καὶ καλέσετε ταύτην τὴν ἡμέραν κλητὴν, ἁγία ἔσται ὑμῖν, πᾶν ἔργον λατρευτὸν οὐ ποιήσετε ἐν αὐτῇ, νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν.» Ἀπαρχὴ μὲν γὰρ καὶ οἱονεὶ πρωτόλειον τῆς εἰς καινότητα μεταπλαττομένης κτίσεως ὁ Ἐμμανουὴλ, νοεῖται δὲ πρῶτος ἐν ἡμῖν, ὡς ἄρτος καὶ νέον φύραμα, τρίβον δὲ ὥσπερ τὴν εἰς τὸ χρῆμα λοιπὸν ἑλόντες ἡμεῖς, καθ' ὁμοιότητα τὴν πρὸς αὐτὸν, νέον ὥσπερ τι καὶ ἡμεῖς κεκλήμεθα φύραμα. Τύπος δ' ἂν εἴη καὶ τοῦδε σαφὴς, ὁ ἐκ νέων καρπῶν προσκομιζόμενος ἄρτος, ἀλλ' οὐχ εἷς ὁ ἄρτος, δύο δὲ χρῆναι προσάγεσθαι λέγει· δύο γὰρ οἱ λαοὶ, κἂν εἰ πρὸς ἑνότητα φαίνοιντο συνενηνεγμένοι διὰ μεσίτου Χριστοῦ· πλὴν ἐζυμωμένοι πεφθήσονται, φησί. Καὶ τί τὸ αἴνιγμα, φέρε λέγωμεν, τὸ τοῦ νόμου βάθος, ὡς ἔνι, καλῶς περιαθρήσαντες. Ἆρα γὰρ ζύμην ἐν τούτοις ἐννοεῖν ἀκόλουθον, τὴν ὡς ἐν φαυλότητι καὶ κατεψευσμένην; Εἶτα πῶς οὐ μωρία τοῦτό γε; πῶς γὰρ ἂν ἔτι κακίας ἀπαλλάξαιμεν, τοὺς εἰς καινότητα πολιτείας εὐαγγελικῆς μετεσκευασμένους; ἢ πῶς ἂν
pass_a_gloss: CYR.: (new things not) you will eat, he says, until into this very day, until you bring the gifts to your God. For the fitting time for needing to partake of the new and undefiled life would be the only one, and very fittingly, according to which Emmanuel shone forth. And sufficient before him altogether no one, to change us over into new life, but as it were firstfruit and first himself of those created into incorruption, inasmuch as he appeared man, and in flesh with us, on account of the likeness toward us. And he brought in at once a clear pre-typing of the holy Pentecost for us, saying it is necessary to count seven weeks onto the bringing-in of the sheaf. For after the resurrection day of the Savior, stringing together seven weeks, we who have believed keep feast. PALL.: How clear the word! CYR.: And that the time of the resurrection of our Savior changes over those sanctified in Spirit, and justified in faith, into being able to bear fruit of the new and unadulterated life, he showed clearly saying thus at once: 'And you will offer a new sacrifice to the Lord, from your dwelling you will offer loaves as an offering, two loaves, from two tenths of fine flour will be the one loaf, leavened they will be baked of firstborn things to the Lord, and you will bring with the loaves seven blameless yearling lambs, and one calf from the herds, and two blameless rams, and they will be for a whole burnt offering to the Lord, and their sacrifices and their libations, sacrifice smell of sweet savor to the Lord. And they will make one he-goat from the goats concerning sin, and two yearling lambs for a sacrifice of salvation with the loaves of the firstborn produce. And the priest will set them with the loaves of the firstborn produce as an offering before the Lord with the two lambs, holy they will be to the Lord, to the priest offering them it will be his. And you will call this day called, holy it will be to you, every work of service you will not do on it, lasting ordinance into your generations in all your dwelling.' For firstfruit and as it were first prize of the creation being remolded into newness is Emmanuel, and he is understood first among us, as bread and new dough, and we, as it were having taken the track toward the matter for the rest, according to likeness toward him, as it were something new we too have been called dough. And a clear type of this too would be the bread brought from new crops, but not one the bread, but he says two must be brought; for two the peoples, even if they seem brought together into unity through Christ the mediator; except leavened they will be baked, he says. And what the riddle, come, let us say, having well looked around the depth of the law as far as possible. For is it consistent to conceive in these the leaven as in baseness and falsified? Then how is this not folly? For how would we still release from evil those refashioned into newness of evangelical citizenship? Or how would (continues)
pass_b_english: Cyril: …eat,’ it says, ‘until this very day, until you have brought the gifts to your God’ (Leviticus 23:14). For the fitting time to share in the new and undefiled life could only be, and very reasonably, the time when Emmanuel shone forth. Before him no one at all was able to refashion us into a new life; but he himself is, as it were, the firstfruits and the first of those created for incorruption, inasmuch as he appeared as a man and was in the flesh with us, because of his likeness to us. And at once the law introduced a clear foreshadowing of holy Pentecost for us, saying that seven weeks must be counted from the bringing of the sheaf. For after the day of the Savior's resurrection we who have believed count seven weeks together and keep the feast.
Palladius: How clear the account is!

Cyril: And that the time of our Savior's resurrection moves those sanctified in the Spirit and justified in faith into the power to bear the fruit of the new and genuine life, it showed clearly by saying straight away:

‘And you shall offer a new sacrifice to the Lord. From your dwelling you shall bring loaves as an offering, two loaves; the one loaf shall be of two tenths of fine flour; they shall be baked leavened, as firstfruits to the Lord. And with the loaves you shall bring seven lambs without blemish, a year old, and one calf from the herd, and two rams without blemish; and they shall be a whole burnt offering to the Lord, with their sacrifices and their drink offerings, a sacrifice, a fragrant odor to the Lord. And they shall offer one male goat from the goats for sin, and two lambs a year old for a sacrifice of salvation, with the loaves of the firstfruits. And the priest shall set them with the loaves of the firstfruits as an offering before the Lord, with the two lambs; they shall be holy to the Lord; they shall belong to the priest who offers them. And you shall proclaim this day a day of assembly; it shall be holy to you; you shall do no work of service on it. It is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations, in all your dwelling’ (Leviticus 23:16–21).

For Emmanuel is the firstfruits and, as it were, the first yield of the creation being refashioned into newness; and he is understood to be first among us, as bread and new dough. And we, taking as it were the path to the same thing, have been called a new dough too, in likeness to him. The bread brought from the new crops would be a clear type of this as well. But it says that not one loaf but two must be offered; for the peoples are two, even if they appear brought together into unity through Christ the mediator. Yet ‘they shall be baked leavened,’ it says. And what is the riddle? Come, let us say, after looking well, as far as we can, into the depth of the law. Is it consistent to understand leaven here as the leaven of wickedness and falsehood? Then how is that not foolishness? For how could we still count as rid of evil those who have been refashioned for the newness of the gospel way of life? Or how could…

choices.why: Kept literal (not 'peace offering') because Cyril plays on σωτήριον / σώζει in §21.

choices.term: πῶς γὰρ ἂν ἔτι κακίας ἀπαλλάξαιμεν
choices.english: how could we still count as rid of evil
choices.why: ἀπαλλάττω τινά τινος, release someone from something; Cyril asks how the people could be called free of evil if the leaven were evil.
